properties.name: style
properties.description: 透传给组件根节点的内联样式

properties.name: className
properties.description: 挂到组件根节点的样式名

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: 输入框初始值

properties.name: displayContent
properties.description: 自定义展示的文本

properties.name: displayEditIcon
properties.description: 自定义编辑图标标签

properties.name: title
properties.description: 弹出框标题, 不写则表示无标题

properties.name: type
properties.description: 输入框的类型

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: 触发方式。优先级高于在 arcoPopconfirmProps 设置的 trigger

properties.name: maxLength
properties.description: 输入框能够输入的最大字数

properties.name: maxLengthErrorMsg
properties.description: 自定义超出最大字数显示时的错误提示； 默认提示为：已超出字符数最大限制

properties.name: rules
properties.description: 输入框的校验规则

properties.name: position
properties.description: 窗口出现的位置。优先级高于在 arcoPopconfirmProps 设置的 position

properties.name: width
properties.description: 气泡宽度

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: 输入框提示文字

properties.name: okButtonProps
properties.description: 确定按钮的参数；可接受 Button 组件的所有参数。优先级高于在 arcoPopconfirmProps 设置的 okButtonProps

properties.name: cancelButtonProps
properties.description: 取消按钮的参数；可接受 Button 组件的所有参数。优先级高于在 arcoPopconfirmProps 设置的 cancelButtonProps

properties.name: showCopy
properties.description: 是否显示 copy 图标

properties.name: cCopyProps
properties.description: CCopy 组件Props。 优先级高级在 cEllipsisProps 设置的 cCopyProps

properties.name: cEllipsisProps
properties.description: CEllipsisProps 组件 Props（除了 content, children）

properties.name: showEdit
properties.description: 是否显示编辑按钮。如果设置成 false 则只有 hover 时才显示

properties.name: arcoInputProps
properties.description: 透传 arcoInputProps

properties.name: arcoTextareaProps
properties.description: 透传 arcoTextareaProps

properties.name: arcoPopconfirmProps
properties.description: 透传 arcoPopconfirmProps

properties.name: arcoPopoverProps
properties.description: 透传 arcoPopoverProps

properties.name: suffix
properties.description: 后缀

properties.name: emptyNode
properties.description: 没有数据的时候显示的元素

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: 编辑功能是否禁用（编辑图标是否禁用）

properties.name: onOk
properties.description: 点击确认按钮时执行的函数

properties.name: onCancel
properties.description: 点击取消按钮时执行的函数
